description: Use this when the user wants to open Xenition's no-code app builder themselves, pre-filled with their idea, to shape the app by hand. This builds nothing — it returns a link that opens the builder. To have the app built for them from the conversation, use build_app instead.

idea.description: a clear description of the app to build, distilled from the conversation (e.g. 'a task tracker with projects, due dates, and team assignments')

mobile.description: true to also target mobile (web + mobile), otherwise web only

name: open_app_builder
title: Open the app builder
